_note: The demo dataset for ERP Master: MyTech Products & Services Sdn Bhd, an invented Malaysian reseller of consumer tech and services. Every brand, company, person, email and phone number here is made up; every email address ends in example.com.

Dates are OFFSETS IN DAYS from the seeding day, never fixed dates: -348 is 348 days before the day demo.py runs, +11 is eleven days after it. The dataset therefore stays "the last twelve months" whenever it is reseeded.

Record numbers are never written here. Orders take the number the auto-number control mints; an invoice Number is built at seed time from its journal prefix, the year of its Accounting Date and its position in that series. Every record is matched on a key of its own: a tag on its path, a contact on its key, a product or variant on its Internal Reference, an order on its Customer Reference (or Template Name), an invoice on its Customer Reference, a line on (its parent, its Sequence).
Amounts: order and invoice line Subtotal/Total are formulas and the four invoice amounts are written by Invoice Lines' roll-up workflow, so no total is written here.

Payments: an invoice's `paid` is what has been received on it (paid out, on a bill) and `paid_offset` the day of the latest payment. There are no payment records: the document carries Amount Paid, Last Payment Date and Payment Status (nothing paid: Not Paid; the whole Total: Paid; otherwise Partially Paid), and its Amount Due is Total less Amount Paid. Every posted document is paid in full on a day between its invoice date and its due date, except the six OVERDUE ones: five unpaid and one partly paid.
